findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential async context security issues
 * @description Checking for potential async context leaks or insecure async operations
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/async-context
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-200
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Look for potential async context issues
  call = API::moduleImport("asyncio").getMember(["get_event_loop", "get_running_loop", "set_event_loop"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("contextvars").getMember(["copy_context", "ContextVar"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential async context security concern - check for proper context isolation"
findings.hypothesis: Potential async context security issues in async detection library

message.text: Potential async context security concern - check for proper context isolation
